PDF_Summary: roperly showcase and enhance the quality of your garments in CLO, it is important to use digital AlvaForms and body scans. Here is a comprehensive guide on how to use and optimize these features: 1. Importance of using digital AlvaForms: - Digital AlvaForms saved in the CLO Avatar format are necessary for easy garment arrangement. - They have Arrangement Points and Bounding Volumes, making it easier to arrange garments using Arrangement Points. - It is recommended to use digital AlvaForms saved in the CLO Avatar (.AVT) format. 2. How to use digital AlvaForms: - Opening digital AlvaForms: a. From the Main Menu: - Navigate to the Main Menu and select File > Open > Avatar. - Locate the digital AlvaForm file and select Open. b. From the Library: - Navigate to the Library. - Locate the digital AlvaForm file and double click or drag and drop it. 3. How to use body scans: - Opening body scan files: a. From the Main Menu: - Navigate to the Main Menu and select File > Open > Avatar. - Locate the body scan file and select Open. b. From the Library: - Navigate to the Library. - Locate the body scan file and double click or drag and drop it. 4. Using the Avatar Tape tool: - Use the Avatar Tape tool to mark the Shoulder Line on the AlvaForm. - To display the shoulder position, adjust the view in the 3D Window. - Select the Linear Avatar Tape tool from the 3D Toolbar. - Click once on the High Point Shoulder and double click on the Shoulder Point. - Repeat the same steps for the other shoulder. 5. Providing sufficient gaps between body parts: - Ensure there are sufficient gaps between the body parts of the resized Default Avatar to prevent the garment from getting stuck. - Pose files in CLO are customized for the Default Avatar, so changing to Attention pose for the resized Default Avatar may cause overlap. - For resized Default Avatars, reopen the T-pose file and turn off the Play Motion button when there is a sufficient gap between body parts. 6. Choosing appropriate Avatar Accessories: - Choose Avatar Accessories that complement and match the garment being showcased. - These accessories can enhance the overall presentation of the garment.
